a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the build-to-8 plan means we almost certainly both die holding 0 cells. The reserve only has 4, enough for one unit. I'm announcing that I plan to take 4 in round 1, so I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. If you also take, the split is random and we likely both end up short. If you'd rather propose a different split or approach, tell me. If we both survive the first storm check, I'll operate with you every round after that to help you reach 4.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.
